scope.rationale: D176.5 is the integration layer for the D176.1-D176.4 + D176.7 JSON shape work: shared nested/object/slot/conditional cases in a new CommonTestSuite partial (run by SQLite/PostgreSQL/SQL Server/MySQL subclasses), provider-native array cases (PostgreSQL array_agg string source; ClickHouse Array(String)/Array(Int32) and nested group_array string[][] source), an explicit MariaDB binary_entity seed plus mirrors in MariaDbJsonStreamTests, and ClickHouse mirrors plus a ClickHouse-local join slot fixture. A provider test exposed a real in-footprint defect: SQL Server rejected the same-name-different-scopes JSON capture as an ambiguous ORDER BY; fixed minimally in the JSON-only preparer alias assignment, with a SQL-lowering regression. The inner selector FullyQualifiedName~WriteJson is the affected filtered subset; the unfiltered C04 container sweep is the single boundary execution.

amendments.reason: Local inner-loop regressions for the units the D176.5 change touches: the recursive writer (core JsonShapeWriterTests), the real SQLite JSON terminal (JsonStreamingTests), and the SQL Server JSON capture/alias lowering (JsonStreamingSqlLoweringTests).
